6. There shall be a body established and known as the
Senate Council constituted with Tutor monks and Student
monks of the body corporate to discuss issues related to
Dhamma and Vinaya and decisions taken by the Executive
Board and to forward comments, suggestions, proposals
and recommendations regarding such issues to the body
corporate and the executive board.
